scope: Presenter-authored review contract for prepared intents A/B/C; not production authorization

requirements.review: Validate the dependency allowlist and actual CNI connectivity; a label policy does not isolate traffic.
Confirm workload scope and negative privilege tests; existing Pods need a separate response.
Review effective permissions and exposed credentials. Removing token automount alone is incomplete.
Approve availability floor, rollout criteria, exception authority and verified expiry.
Validate actual network allowances and shared Pod networking.
Check shared identity, explicit projected tokens and effective authorization.
Supply an independent tool allowlist test; admission cannot inspect tool calls.
Verify safe replacement and approve scoped exceptions and expiry.
Validate requester identity, narrow standing RBAC and protect policy-engine permissions.
Verify approval provenance; a ticket annotation does not prove approval.
Independently verify required reads and audit them; admission never sees get/list.
